standard_prerequisites.name: Flat closed immersions of finite presentation

core_obligations: Flat closed immersion: descend-etale and descend-closed-immersion-fp give f_i etale and a closed immersion, hence flat closed immersion; the flat-closed-immersion-fp lemma identifies X_i with an open-and-closed subscheme of Y_i.

Image containment and surjectivity: the image of Y -> Y_i lies in f_i(X_i); limit-contained-in-constructible moves it to Y_{i'} for some i' >= i; then X_{i'} -> Y_{i'} is surjective, hence an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Etale + closed immersion at a level.
Open-and-closed identification via the flat-closed-immersion lemma.
Containment moves to a finite level; surjectivity closes.
difficulty_reason: descend-etale + descend-closed-immersion-fp give f_i flat closed immersion; the flat-closed-immersion-fp lemma makes it an open-and-closed immersion; the constructible containment moves the image to a finite level; surjectivity closes.
